'''Yeddu''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Kadas'sa'Nikto/Legends|Kadas'sa'Nikto]] who lived in the [[Nikto Sector]] of [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. When the [[Kintan Kings]] took over the sector, they killed [[Yeddu's brother|his brother]] for not paying protection money, so Yeddu developed a plan to permanently disable the gang's swoop bikes with EMP charges.
